supported_fields.mechanics: Button-mash chargeable Ki Blast Super with three stages. Stage 1 causes minor hitstun; Stage 2 can restand/juggle-reset and stun; Stage 3 produces greater knockback and damage. Higher stages take longer to fire.

limits: No universal damage numbers or frame timings are inferred.
